blocks.h2: Is It Your Drain or the Building's?
blocks.body: Call when plunging hasn't worked, the same drain clogs again soon or you smell sewage. Then check who else is affected. If only your sink or tub is slow, the clog is in your branch line. If the upstairs unit's drains are slow too, or the basement floor drain is filling, the shared main line is blocked and needs [sewer rodding](/chicago-ravenswood/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

bodies: Hair and soap in bathrooms, grease in kitchens and lint from laundry cause most clogs. We clear them with a cable sized for the pipe and show you what came out.

Many Ravenswood homes still have original galvanized and cast iron drains. They narrow with age, so clogs come back faster. A camera look tells us whether a stubborn drain needs [hydro jetting](/chicago-ravenswood/hydro-jetting) or a section of pipe replaced.
Grease is behind most kitchen clogs. It coats the pipe and traps food and soap.

In a two-flat or condo, stacked kitchens often share a drain. If your sink backs up when your neighbor's dishwasher runs, the clog is in the shared line. If the disposal is involved, see [garbage disposal repair](/chicago-ravenswood/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Ravenswood Homes
blocks.intro: Century-old pipe and shared lines make clogs a regular call here.

items.body: Several units share one vertical drain.
When every unit is slow, it's the main. See [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When the basement floor drain backs up or every unit's drains slow down, the main sewer drain is blocked. It takes a machine that can reach from the cleanout to the city sewer.

We clear it and scope it so you see the cause, usually roots in old clay or grease from several kitchens. If it keeps happening, we'll go over [rodding](/chicago-ravenswood/sewer-rodding), [jetting](/chicago-ravenswood/hydro-jetting) or a [repair](/chicago-ravenswood/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: Do you offer emergency drain cleaning?
items.answer: Yes. Call any time and we'll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Why does my sink back up when upstairs runs water?
items.answer: Your units share a drain line, and the clog is below your fixture in the shared part.

items.q: Can you clear an old clawfoot tub drain?
items.answer: Yes. Older tub drains have their own quirks, and we have the tools for them.

items.q: Should I use a chemical drain cleaner?
items.answer: We don't recommend it, especially on old galvanized or cast iron.

items.q: Can you clear a stack clog without entering every unit?
items.answer: Usually, from the roof vent or a cleanout. We'll let you know if we need access.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on where the clog is. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. You'll approve a flat price before we start.
